LIFE-157: Stock reserved from a warehouse that doesn't exist

A logistics officer reserved 40 food kits from "WH7". There is no such warehouse, but
the system accepted it, and the kits never shipped.

Ask: make reserve_stock (inventory/stock.py) reject any reservation whose warehouse code
is not in the correct format. Raise a ValueError (or a subclass of it) and do not record
anything in the ledger when a code is rejected.

Done when: malformed warehouse codes are rejected with an error, and reservations with
correct codes still work as before.
